brief:
Jawwal, a Palestinian telecommunications company, is providing strategic sponsorship for the third international conference on digital transformation and artificial intelligence, according to Ma'an Wire. The initiative aims to position Palestine on the global map of digital transformation and AI development.

The conference is part of broader efforts to implement a vision that places Palestinian technological advancement within international digital innovation frameworks.
